provenance.source: JPL Horizons heliocentric state at the fixed 2026-09-03 TT scene epoch. Arbitrary display pole and meridian. The flyby did not establish a spin pole or current surface longitude; the display orientation is not a measured attitude.
provenance.qualification: Computed Annefrank Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
